Package org.sosy_lab.java_smt.solvers.yices2

Class PushPopYices2Prover

java.lang.Object
org.sosy_lab.java_smt.basicimpl.AbstractProver<Void>
org.sosy_lab.java_smt.basicimpl.AbstractProverWithAllSat<Void>
org.sosy_lab.java_smt.solvers.yices2.PushPopYices2Prover
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable, org.sosy_lab.java_smt.api.BasicProverEnvironment<Void>, org.sosy_lab.java_smt.api.ProverEnvironment
public final class PushPopYices2Prover extends org.sosy_lab.java_smt.basicimpl.AbstractProverWithAllSat<Void>
A Yices prover whose context runs in push-pop mode, as JavaSMT 5 opened it. JavaSMT 6 opens every Yices context in interactive mode, which is much slower on the incremental queries of the OC checker. It lives in JavaSMT's package because the context factory method it overrides is package-private.

Checks also use the search parameters Yices tunes for the context, as JavaSMT 5 did by passing none; JavaSMT 6 passes a fresh parameter record holding the generic defaults.
